elements.requirement: The Secretary of State may make arrangements for specified escort functions to be performed by authorised prisoner custody officers in cases determined by or under those arrangements.
elements.quote: The Secretary of State may make arrangements for any of the functions specified in subsection (2) below (“escort functions”) to be performed in such cases as may be determined by or under the arrangements by prisoner custody officers who are authorised to perform such functions.

elements.requirement: Escort functions include the transfer of prisoners from one set of relevant premises to another.
elements.quote: the transfer of prisoners from one set of relevant premises to another

elements.requirement: Escort functions include the custody of prisoners held on court premises, whether or not they would otherwise be in court custody, and their production before the court.
elements.quote: the custody of prisoners held on court premises (whether or not they would otherwise be in the custody of the court) and their production before the court

elements.requirement: Escort functions include the custody of prisoners held in a police station and their production before a court by electronic means from that station.
elements.quote: the custody of prisoners held in a police station and their production, by electronic means from the station, before a court

elements.requirement: Escort functions include the custody of prisoners temporarily held in a prison while being transferred from one prison to another.
elements.quote: the custody of prisoners temporarily held in a prison in the course of transfer from one prison to another

elements.requirement: Escort functions include the custody of prisoners while they are outside a prison for temporary purposes.
elements.quote: the custody of prisoners while they are outside a prison for temporary purposes

elements.requirement: Relevant premises include the premises of any court, prison, police station, or hospital.
elements.quote: the premises of any court, prison, police station or hospital

elements.requirement: Relevant premises include the premises of any other place from or to which a prisoner may be required to be taken under the Criminal Procedure (Scotland) Act 1995 or the Mental Health (Care and Treatment) (Scotland) Act 2003.
elements.quote: the premises of any other place from or to which a prisoner may be required to be taken under the Criminal Procedure (Scotland) Act 1995 or the Mental Health (Care and Treatment) (Scotland) Act 2003

elements.requirement: Either set of relevant premises involved in a transfer, but not both, may be situated in a part of the British Islands outside Scotland.
elements.quote: either (but not both) of the sets of premises mentioned in that paragraph may be situated in a part of the British Islands outside Scotland

elements.requirement: Prisoner escort arrangements made by the Secretary of State may include entering into contracts with other persons to provide prisoner custody officers.
elements.quote: Arrangements made by the Secretary of State under this section (“prisoner escort arrangements”) may include entering into contracts with other persons for the provision by them of prisoner custody officers.

elements.requirement: A person responsible under a warrant or hospital order for performing an escort function is deemed to have complied with that warrant or order if they do all they reasonably can to secure that the function is performed by an authorised prisoner custody officer under prisoner escort arrangements or by a police custody and security officer under section 28 of the Police and Fire Reform (Scotland) Act 2012.
elements.quote: Any person who, under a warrant or hospital order, is responsible for the performance of any such function as is mentioned in subsection (2) above shall be deemed to have complied with that warrant or order if he does all that he reasonably can to secure that the function is performed by a prisoner custody officer acting in pursuance of prisoner escort arrangements or by a police custody and security officer in the performance of functions under section 28 of the Police and Fire Reform (Scotland) Act 2012 (asp 8).

elements.requirement: The term 'hospital' has the same meaning as given in the Mental Health (Care and Treatment) (Scotland) Act 2003.
elements.quote: “hospital” has the same meaning as in the Mental Health (Care and Treatment) (Scotland) Act 2003

elements.requirement: A 'hospital order' means an order for a person's detention in, or admission to and detention in, a hospital under section 52D, 52M, 53, 54 or 57A of the Criminal Procedure (Scotland) Act 1995.
elements.quote: “hospital order” means an order for a person’s detention in, or admission to and detention in, a hospital under section 52D, 52M, 53, 54 or 57A of the Act of 1995

elements.requirement: A 'warrant' means a warrant for committal, a warrant for arrest, a transfer for treatment direction under section 136 of the Mental Health (Care and Treatment) (Scotland) Act 2003, or any other warrant, order, or direction under that Act or the Criminal Procedure (Scotland) Act 1995 requiring a person to be taken to a particular place.
elements.quote: “warrant” means a warrant for committal, a warrant for arrest, a transfer for treatment direction under section 136 of the Mental Health (Care and Treatment) (Scotland) Act 2003 or any other warrant, order or direction under the Act of 1995 or the Mental Health (Care and Treatment) (Scotland) Act 2003 requiring a person to be taken to a particular place

thresholds.what: The maximum number of sets of relevant premises that may be situated in a part of the British Islands outside Scotland during a transfer
thresholds.quote: either (but not both) of the sets of premises mentioned in that paragraph may be situated in a part of the British Islands outside Scotland
